mostWorthwhile.text: Building the biceps from the fibre bundle was most worthwhile: the description connects the sheaths to tendons and explains how they carry a pull to move the elbow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate biceps fitting was straightforward but added no explanation, so it felt more like assembly than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: I found it useful that the connective tissue sheaths gather into tendons, linking the fibres' shortening to a pull on the arm.

arbitrary.text: Combining the skeleton with blood vessels produced the arm assembly, but the result did not explain why the vessels were needed at that point.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the progression from fibres to tendons and opposing muscles made the movement easier to understand, even though several choices were routine.
